motivation: v0.64 rejected the narrow scale-dependent P_m peak as tangent-amplitude non-robust, while the smooth sigma8 response remained sign-stable and comparatively insensitive to lambda. v0.65 tests only this smooth late-time growth response in the zero-amplitude tangent limit.

source_results.policy: The rejected v0.64 narrow P_m feature is not promoted or rescued in v0.65.

primary_observable.interpretation: R0(z) estimates d ln sigma8 / d eta at eta=0.

secondary_observable.summary_policy: Report median response over the fixed k grid, 10-90 percent range, and sign fraction at each z. Do not rank or select by maxima or RMS.

s8_identity.statement: At fixed Omega_m, d ln S8 / d eta equals d ln sigma8 / d eta.

classification_policy.meaning: PASS is a data-blind numerical certification of a smooth negative late-time growth response. It is not an observational detection.

anti_tuning: No observational data are used. Do not change the frozen cosmology, KB, tauH0, p, CLASS commit, lambda sequence, primary redshift set, response definition, extrapolation form, or gates after reading v0.65 results. A FAIL is retained as a scientific null/falsification of the proposed smooth-growth tangent limit.
